page.overview:
What is Beach Boy?

The Stand appears as a simple fishing pole with the words 'BEACH BOY' written on top (omitted in the anime) and a monstrous skull as the reel, meant to represent death.

Pesci summons it by making it come out of his palm.

Beach Boy sports a grey metallic color in the digitally colored manga, while the anime presents it as a dark blue rod and pink line.

Despite its innocuous appearance, Beach Boy is a remarkably deadly Stand, both at long and short range. Initially held back by Pesci's cowardly nature, its full potential and User's later growth makes it dangerous enough to face Bucciarati head on.
